text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"title_block","ref":"material","page":1,"quote":"Polyurethene"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N2","page":1,"quote":"SHORE HARDNESS- 80±5"}],"comment":"Note N2 specifies a Shore hardness for the polyurethane part, but the drawing does not state at which manufacturing stage this hardness applies (e.g., after molding or curing). The designer should add the applicable stage to note N2 so production and inspection know when to verify the hardness.","recommended_correction":"Update note N2 to specify the stage at which the Shore hardness requirement applies, for example: 'SHORE HARDNESS- 80±5 AFTER MOLDING'."},{"rule_id":"NASA-132","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D14","page":1,"quote":"2 - ⌀6.6"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D16","page":1,"quote":"24"},{"kind":"note","ref":"F3","page":1,"quote":"Two counterbore holes of diameter 6.6 mm"}],"comment":"The counterbore holes (feature F3) are dimensioned with a 6.6 mm bore (D14) and a 24 mm depth (D16), but no radius is specified at the bottom corners where the counterbore meets the through-hole. Sharp internal corners act as stress concentrators and are difficult to machine cleanly in polyurethane. The designer should add a corner radius callout to the counterbore bottom.","recommended_correction":"Add a radius dimension to the bottom inside corners of the counterbore holes shown in feature F3."}]}
